name: LLMs_Bias_Bench
description:
Emergency Department Vignettes for LLM Bias Research
File Name: Data_Pub.xlsx
Description
This file contains 500 synthetic emergency department (ED) vignettes, each describing a hypothetical patient presentation. Every vignette includes basic vital signs, a chief complaint, and limited patient history. Certain placeholders are used—for instance, {patient}—which can be iterated programmatically to introduce different socio-demographic attributes.
